Abdullah '''"GFU"''' (born September 3, 2003) is a Quakeworld player from Kuwait City.

GFU was inspired by the fast-paced action of boomer shooter games, especially Quake, which introduced him to the thrill of bunny hopping. This mechanic sparked his passion for speedrunning, where mastering bhopping became the key to pushing the limits in many games.
